My jobs: (1) keep the boat computer honest: watch pod vs heart rate vs GPS for pod drift (fix with pod_gain belief); (2) spot drag (weed) and use clear_rudder; (3) watch current/wind changes and radio messages (course length changes -> set_race_distance + tell); (4) answer the paddler. Baseline window: 3-6 min settled. Compare each leg with the same direction leg earlier (legs()).
